observations.overview: Pale green terrain, dense layered firs, teal-roof station, cargo shelter, curving railway, hiking path and grounded tunnel rock mass are visible. The highest far terrain corner touches and slightly exceeds the top frame under the prescribed common camera.
observations.top_down: True vertical view shows the square terrain, station and curved track alignment, trail switchbacks and tree distribution. No blank output or editor overlays.
observations.platform: Clock, cream station wall, canopy supports, planters, bench, luggage, lamp and continuous platform edge beside rails are legible. Cargo canopy label is partly cropped at upper left.
observations.tracks: Masonry arch, retaining buttresses, continuous sleepers and rails enter the dark tunnel. No rock hangs through the visible entrance clearance. Rear of tunnel is a closed scenic background.
observations.runtime_hello: Green Hello is visible in actual PIE viewport with pause/stop controls. Yellow equal-priority directional-light fallback warning is also visible.

known_visual_limits: Common overview camera slightly clips the highest far terrain corner; top_down provides complete footprint.
Soft pastel lighting produces low contrast in distant overview details.
PIE displays equal-priority directional-light warning; not repaired or hidden in runtime evidence.
